title: Make Story 1.2 mutation locking single-winner and ownership-safe
summary: Correct the remaining F6 concurrency defect. Implement an atomic single-winner mutation-lock acquisition and stale-reclamation protocol, bind release to the exact acquired lock incarnation, fail closed on incomplete or ambiguous metadata, and add genuine barrier-synchronized multiprocess regressions for stale contention, N contenders, successor-safe release, PID-reuse-shaped identity, reboot/host mismatch, incomplete metadata, active owners, and repeated stale reclaim. Preserve all other frozen Story 1.2 transaction semantics and rerun the complete deterministic gate set.
